title: Parents
subtitle: Follow-up accounts: sign-in details and the link between each parent and their children.

status.activeHint: Has at least one active student

form.createDesc: The account is created manually and written to the database — public sign-up is disabled.
form.editDesc: Name and an optional password reset, plus linking and unlinking children.
form.name: Full name
form.phoneHint: Required — this is the guardian's main reminder channel. Use the international format, e.g. +201012345678.
form.passwordHint: At least 8 characters — changed by the user on first sign-in.
form.resetHint: Leave it empty to keep the current password.
form.primaryGuardianNote: Each student has exactly one primary guardian — a student who already has one is added for follow-up only.

errors.name: Name is required.
errors.phone: Enter a valid phone number: 8 to 15 digits, optionally starting with +.
errors.phoneRequired: A phone number is required — without one the guardian gets no session reminder.
errors.password: Password must be at least 8 characters.

saveFailed: Could not save the parent account.

drawer.title: Parent profile
drawer.noChildren: No children linked to this account.
drawer.contactEmptyDesc: The platform keeps no call log; contact happens outside it, as agreed.

readOnly: View only — account management belongs to supervisors and above.

noParents.title: No parents yet
noParents.desc: Add the first parent and link them to their children.
